content.bridge_context: We look at the Earth as a single unit—a home shared by all living beings—emphasizing our responsibility to protect it.

units.title: Earth's Layers and Features
units.explanation: Earth consists of the Lithosphere (land), Hydrosphere (water), and Atmosphere (air). The Biosphere is where life exists.
units.dual_language_instruction: Label the spheres. / पृथ्वी के क्षेत्रों को अंकित करें।

units.title: Global Environmental Issues
units.explanation: Challenges like global warming, pollution, and habitat loss affect the whole planet.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify a global problem. / एक वैश्विक समस्या की पहचान करें।
